title: Gaussian Splatting 성도
summary: 3DGS(2023)는 NeRF 계열의 느린 광선 행진을 이방성 가우시안의 정렬 래스터화로 바꿔 실시간 고품질 렌더링을 열었습니다. 이후 압축·LOD, 기하 정확도(2DGS), 동적 장면(4DGS), 레이 트레이싱(3DGRT·3DGUT), 새 프리미티브(Triangle Splatting), 피드포워드 재구성 갈래로 퍼졌고, 지금도 매달 새 별이 뜨는 활발한 분야입니다.

nodes.title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields
nodes.label: 2D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.note: 3D 타원체를 2D 원판(surfel)으로 바꾸고 ray-splat 교차를 정확히 계산. 기하 정확도의 기준.
nodes.note_en: Replaces 3D ellipsoids with 2D discs (surfels) and computes ray–splat intersections exactly. The reference for geometric accuracy.

nodes.title: 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing: Fast Tracing of Particle Scenes
nodes.label: 3DGRT
nodes.note: 가우시안을 BVH에 넣어 하드웨어 레이 트레이싱. 반사·굴절·그림자 같은 2차 광선 가능.
nodes.note_en: Puts Gaussians into a BVH for hardware ray tracing, enabling secondary rays such as reflection, refraction and shadows.

nodes.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
nodes.label: 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.note: 이방성 3D 가우시안 + SH 색 + 타일 기반 정렬 래스터화(CUDA). 적응형 밀집화로 실시간 고품질 NVS를 연 논문.
nodes.note_en: Anisotropic 3D Gaussians with SH colour, rendered by tile-based sorted rasterisation in CUDA. Adaptive densification made real-time, high-quality novel view synthesis possible.

nodes.title: 3DGUT: Enabling Distorted Cameras and Secondary Rays in Gaussian Splatting
nodes.label: 3DGUT
nodes.note: EWA의 선형 근사 대신 Unscented Transform으로 투영. 왜곡 카메라와 2차 광선을 래스터화 속도로.
nodes.note_en: Replaces EWA's linear approximation with the Unscented Transform, supporting distorted cameras and secondary rays at rasterisation speed.

nodes.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering
nodes.label: 4DGS (HexPlane)
nodes.note: HexPlane 특징으로 가우시안 변형장을 인코딩해 실시간 동적 장면 렌더링.
nodes.note_en: Encodes the Gaussian deformation field with HexPlane features for real-time dynamic scene rendering.

nodes.title: ADATEX4D: Adaptive Texture Capacity Allocation for 4D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.label: AdaTex4D
nodes.note: 변형 기반 4DGS의 가우시안별 RGBA 트라이플레인 해상도를 화면공간 기울기로 적응 할당. 텍스처 저장 50%↓.
nodes.note_en: Sizes each Gaussian's RGBA triplane texture in deformation-based 4DGS from screen-space gradients; halves texture storage.

nodes.title: Deformable Beta Splatting
nodes.label: Deformable Beta Splatting
nodes.note: 베타 커널로 형태를 조절하고 색도 구면 베타로 표현해 SH 대비 메모리 절감.
nodes.note_en: Beta kernels with adjustable shape, and spherical-beta colour that uses less memory than SH.

nodes.title: Budgeted-GS: Real-Time Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting via Factoring LOD
nodes.label: Budgeted-GS
nodes.note: 학습된 3DGS를 moment-matched 계층으로 바꿔 디바이스 메모리 예산에 맞춘 per-view LOD. 최적수송 기반 예산-오차 법칙.
nodes.note_en: Turns a trained 3DGS into a moment-matched hierarchy and picks per-view LOD to fit a device's memory budget. Grounded in an optimal-transport budget–error law.

nodes.title: CityGaussian: Real-time High-quality Large-Scale Scene Rendering with Gaussians
nodes.label: CityGaussian
nodes.note: 분할 정복 학습과 압축 기반 LOD로 도시 규모 장면 렌더링.
nodes.note_en: Divide-and-conquer training and compression-based LOD for city-scale scenes.

nodes.title: Structure-from-Motion Revisited
nodes.label: COLMAP (SfM Revisited)
nodes.note: 증분식 SfM 파이프라인. 3DGS는 COLMAP이 만든 카메라 포즈와 희소 점군으로 가우시안을 초기화한다.
nodes.note_en: Incremental structure-from-motion pipeline. 3DGS initialises its Gaussians from the camera poses and sparse points that COLMAP produces.

nodes.title: Compact 3D Gaussian Representation for Radiance Field
nodes.label: Compact 3DGS
nodes.note: 학습 가능한 마스크로 가우시안 수를 줄이고 색을 해시 그리드로 표현.
nodes.note_en: A learned mask removes Gaussians, and colour moves into a hash grid.

nodes.title: 3D Convex Splatting: Radiance Field Rendering with 3D Smooth Convexes
nodes.label: 3D Convex Splatting
nodes.note: 가우시안 대신 부드러운 볼록 다면체를 프리미티브로. 날카로운 경계 표현에 유리.
nodes.note_en: Smooth 3D convex polytopes replace Gaussians as primitives, which suits sharp edges.

nodes.title: Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
nodes.label: Deformable 3DGS
nodes.note: 정준 공간 가우시안 + 시간 조건 변형 MLP. 단안 동적 장면 재구성.
nodes.note_en: Canonical-space Gaussians plus a time-conditioned deformation MLP; dynamic scenes from monocular video.

nodes.title: DepthSplat: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth
nodes.label: DepthSplat
nodes.note: 단안 깊이 사전학습 특징과 MVSplat을 결합해 깊이·NVS를 함께 개선.
nodes.note_en: Combines pretrained monocular depth features with MVSplat to improve both depth and novel view synthesis.

nodes.title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation
nodes.label: DreamGaussian
nodes.note: SDS로 3DGS를 최적화하는 빠른 text/image-to-3D 생성.
nodes.note_en: Fast text/image-to-3D generation by optimising 3DGS with SDS.

nodes.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis
nodes.label: Dynamic 3D Gaussians
nodes.note: 시간에 따라 가우시안을 이동·회전시키며 추적. 동적 3DGS의 첫 시도.
nodes.note_en: Moves and rotates Gaussians over time and tracks them; the first attempt at dynamic 3DGS.

nodes.title: EVER: Exact Volumetric Ellipsoid Rendering for Real-time View Synthesis
nodes.label: EVER
nodes.note: 일정 밀도 타원체로 볼륨 렌더링 적분을 정확히 계산. popping 없는 레이 트레이싱 렌더링.
nodes.note_en: Constant-density ellipsoids let the volume rendering integral be computed exactly; ray-traced rendering without popping.

nodes.title: EWA Splatting
nodes.label: EWA Splatting
nodes.note: 타원 가우시안 커널을 화면으로 투영하고 저역통과 필터와 합성하는 스플래팅 이론. 3DGS의 2D 공분산 투영(야코비안 근사)이 여기서 온다.
nodes.note_en: Splatting theory that projects elliptical Gaussian kernels to the screen and combines them with a low-pass filter. 3DGS's 2D covariance projection (the Jacobian approximation) comes from here.

nodes.title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
nodes.label: FactorSplat
nodes.note: 의료 볼륨용 N-D 가우시안에서 transfer function을 추론 시 교체. 524 FPS, TF 전환 1.17ms.
nodes.note_en: N-D Gaussian proxies for medical volumes that swap transfer functions at inference: 524 FPS, 1.17 ms per switch.

nodes.title: Learning a Model of Facial Shape and Expression from 4D Scans
nodes.label: FLAME
nodes.note: 형상·표정·포즈를 분리한 파라메트릭 얼굴 모델. 가우시안 헤드 아바타들이 리깅의 뼈대로 쓴다.
nodes.note_en: Parametric face model with separate shape, expression and pose. Gaussian head avatars use it as their rig.

nodes.title: GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians
nodes.label: GaussianAvatars
nodes.note: FLAME 메시 삼각형에 가우시안을 리깅한 포토리얼 헤드 아바타.
nodes.note_en: Photorealistic head avatars with Gaussians rigged to the triangles of a FLAME mesh.

nodes.title: GaussianShader: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Shading Functions for Reflective Surfaces
nodes.label: GaussianShader
nodes.note: 단순화된 셰이딩 함수(diffuse + specular + residual)로 반사 표면 표현.
nodes.note_en: A simplified shading function (diffuse + specular + residual) for reflective surfaces.

nodes.title: Gaussian Opacity Fields: Efficient Adaptive Surface Reconstruction in Unbounded Scenes
nodes.label: Gaussian Opacity Fields
nodes.note: 가우시안의 불투명도 필드에서 레벨셋으로 표면 추출. 무한 장면 메시화.
nodes.note_en: Extracts surfaces as level sets of the Gaussians' opacity field; meshes unbounded scenes.

nodes.title: GS-IR: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Inverse Rendering
nodes.label: GS-IR
nodes.note: 깊이 기반 법선과 베이크된 가시성으로 3DGS 역렌더링(재질·조명 분해).
nodes.note_en: Inverse rendering (material and lighting decomposition) for 3DGS using depth-derived normals and baked visibility.

nodes.title: HAC: Hash-grid Assisted Context for 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression
nodes.label: HAC
nodes.note: 해시 그리드 문맥으로 앵커 속성의 엔트로피 코딩. 압축률 대폭 향상.
nodes.note_en: Entropy-codes anchor attributes with a hash-grid context model; a large gain in compression rate.

nodes.title: A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets
nodes.label: Hierarchical 3DGS
nodes.note: 가우시안 병합 계층과 청크 학습으로 수 km 규모 캡처를 실시간 렌더링. 대규모 LOD의 기준점.
nodes.note_en: A hierarchy of merged Gaussians plus chunked training renders kilometre-scale captures in real time. The reference point for large-scale LOD.

nodes.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
nodes.label: Instant-NGP
nodes.note: 다중 해상도 해시 인코딩 + CUDA 최적화로 NeRF 학습을 초 단위로. 3DGS의 속도 비교 기준.
nodes.note_en: Multi-resolution hash encoding plus fused CUDA kernels cut NeRF training to seconds. 3DGS's speed reference.

nodes.title: LightGaussian: Unbounded 3D Gaussian Compression with 15x Reduction and 200+ FPS
nodes.label: LightGaussian
nodes.note: 중요도 기반 가지치기 + SH 증류 + 벡터 양자화로 15배 압축.
nodes.note_en: Importance-based pruning, SH distillation and vector quantisation for 15x compression.

nodes.title: Optical Models for Direct Volume Rendering
nodes.label: Optical Models (Max)
nodes.note: 방출-흡수 볼륨 렌더링 적분식의 고전. NeRF의 렌더링 방정식과 3DGS의 알파 합성이 모두 이 적분의 이산화다.
nodes.note_en: The classic emission–absorption volume rendering integral. NeRF's rendering equation and 3DGS's alpha compositing are both discretisations of it.

nodes.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo
nodes.label: 3DGS-MCMC
nodes.note: 밀집화 휴리스틱을 SGLD 기반 MCMC 샘플링으로 재해석. 초기화 의존성을 줄인 확률적 관점.
nodes.note_en: Recasts the densification heuristics as SGLD-based MCMC sampling, reducing the dependence on initialisation.

nodes.title: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields
nodes.label: Mip-NeRF 360
nodes.note: 무한 장면용 공간 수축과 안티앨리어싱. 3DGS 이전의 품질 최고점이자 3DGS 평가 데이터셋의 출처.
nodes.note_en: Space contraction and anti-aliasing for unbounded scenes. The quality peak before 3DGS and the source of its evaluation scenes.

nodes.title: Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.label: Mip-Splatting
nodes.note: 3D 평활 필터 + 2D Mip 필터로 해상도 변화 시 앨리어싱 제거. 샘플링 이론 관점의 3DGS 수정.
nodes.note_en: A 3D smoothing filter and a 2D mip filter remove aliasing when the resolution changes. A sampling-theory fix to 3DGS.

nodes.title: A Moving Least Squares Material Point Method with Displacement Discontinuity and Two-Way Rigid Body Coupling
nodes.label: MLS-MPM
nodes.note: MPM의 P2G/G2P 전송을 MLS로 재정식화해 단순·고속화한 방법. PhysGaussian이 가우시안을 MPM 입자로 쓰는 기반.
nodes.note_en: Reformulates MPM particle–grid transfers with moving least squares, making them simpler and faster. The basis for using Gaussians as MPM particles in PhysGaussian.

nodes.title: MVSplat: Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-View Images
nodes.label: MVSplat
nodes.note: 코스트 볼륨 기반 깊이로 가우시안 중심을 예측. 더 작고 빠른 피드포워드 모델.
nodes.note_en: Predicts Gaussian centres from cost-volume depth; a smaller, faster feed-forward model.

nodes.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
nodes.label: NeRF
nodes.note: MLP로 표현한 radiance field를 볼륨 렌더링으로 학습. 3DGS가 품질 기준선이자 대체 대상으로 삼은 출발점.
nodes.note_en: Learns a radiance field stored in an MLP through volume rendering. The starting point that 3DGS used as its quality baseline and set out to replace.

nodes.title: Neural Point-Based Graphics
nodes.label: Neural Point-Based Graphics
nodes.note: 점군에 학습 가능한 디스크립터를 붙여 래스터화 후 신경망으로 렌더링. 점 기반 미분 렌더링 계열의 선행 연구.
nodes.note_en: Attaches learned descriptors to a point cloud, rasterises them and decodes with a network. Early work on point-based differentiable rendering.

nodes.title: Octree-GS: Towards Consistent Real-time Rendering with LOD-Structured 3D Gaussians
nodes.label: Octree-GS
nodes.note: 옥트리 레벨별 앵커로 LOD 구조를 만들어 거리에 따라 일관된 실시간 렌더링.
nodes.note_en: Anchors organised by octree level give an LOD structure for consistent real-time rendering at any distance.

nodes.title: PGSR: Planar-based Gaussian Splatting for Efficient and High-Fidelity Surface Reconstruction
nodes.label: PGSR
nodes.note: 평면화된 가우시안과 다시점 기하 일관성으로 고정밀 표면 재구성.
nodes.note_en: Flattened Gaussians plus multi-view geometric consistency for high-precision surface reconstruction.

nodes.title: PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics
nodes.label: PhysGaussian
nodes.note: 가우시안을 MPM 입자로 써 연속체 역학으로 직접 시뮬레이션하고 그대로 렌더링. "보이는 것 = 시뮬레이션하는 것".
nodes.note_en: Uses Gaussians directly as MPM particles, simulates continuum mechanics and renders the result as is: what you see is what you simulate.

nodes.title: pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
nodes.label: pixelSplat
nodes.note: 이미지 쌍에서 가우시안을 한 번에 예측하는 피드포워드 재구성의 시작.
nodes.note_en: Predicts Gaussians from an image pair in one forward pass; the start of feed-forward reconstruction.

nodes.title: Plenoxels: Radiance Fields without Neural Networks
nodes.label: Plenoxels
nodes.note: 신경망 없이 SH 계수를 가진 희소 복셀로 radiance field 표현. "명시적 표현 + SH"라는 3DGS의 직접적 선배.
nodes.note_en: Radiance fields without neural networks: sparse voxels with SH coefficients. The direct predecessor of 3DGS's explicit + SH design.

nodes.title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocation
nodes.label: PocketSplat
nodes.note: 출력 가우시안 개수 예산을 지정하는 피드포워드 재구성. iPhone 온디바이스 실행.
nodes.note_en: Feed-forward reconstruction with a prescribed Gaussian budget; runs on an iPhone.

nodes.title: Relightable 3D Gaussians: Realistic Point Cloud Relighting with BRDF Decomposition and Ray Tracing
nodes.label: Relightable 3D Gaussians
nodes.note: 가우시안별 BRDF 분해 + 점 기반 레이 트레이싱 가시성으로 재조명.
nodes.note_en: Per-Gaussian BRDF decomposition plus point-based ray-traced visibility for relighting.

nodes.title: Real-time Photorealistic Dynamic Scene Representation and Rendering with 4D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.label: Real-time 4DGS
nodes.note: 시공간을 함께 다루는 4D 가우시안 + 4D SH. 시간 슬라이스로 렌더링.
nodes.note_en: 4D Gaussians with 4D SH treat space and time together and are rendered by slicing in time.

nodes.title: Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
nodes.label: Scaffold-GS
nodes.note: 앵커 점에서 신경망으로 가우시안을 생성하는 구조화 표현. 이후 LOD·압축 계열의 기반.
nodes.note_en: Anchor points spawn Gaussians through small networks; a structured representation that later LOD and compression work builds on.

nodes.title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
nodes.label: SCION
nodes.note: 반복 요소를 재사용 프리미티브 + 월드 공간 인스턴스로 표현하는 계층형 3DGS. 1.2MB 압축과 인스턴스 편집.
nodes.note_en: Hierarchical 3DGS that stores repeated elements as reusable primitives plus world-space instances; 1.2 MB scenes and instance editing.

nodes.title: Gaussian Splashing: Unified Particles for Versatile Motion Synthesis and Rendering
nodes.label: Gaussian Splashing
nodes.note: PBD 기반 고체·유체 통합 시뮬레이션과 가우시안 렌더링, 유체 표면 반사까지.
nodes.note_en: PBD-based unified solid and fluid simulation rendered with Gaussians, including reflections on fluid surfaces.

nodes.title: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM
nodes.label: SplaTAM
nodes.note: RGB-D SLAM에서 가우시안을 맵으로 쓰며 추적·매핑 동시 수행.
nodes.note_en: RGB-D SLAM that tracks and maps with Gaussians as the map.

nodes.title: StopThePop: Sorted Gaussian Splatting for View-Consistent Real-time Rendering
nodes.label: StopThePop
nodes.note: 타일 단위 계층적 재정렬로 뷰 회전 시 popping을 제거. 3DGS 래스터라이저의 정렬 근사 문제를 GPU 관점에서 해결.
nodes.note_en: Hierarchical per-tile re-sorting removes popping when the view rotates. Fixes the sorting approximation in the 3DGS rasteriser from a GPU angle.

nodes.title: SuGaR: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Mesh Reconstruction and High-Quality Mesh Rendering
nodes.label: SuGaR
nodes.note: 가우시안을 표면에 정렬시키는 정규화로 메시 추출.
nodes.note_en: A regulariser aligns Gaussians with surfaces so that a mesh can be extracted.

nodes.title: Taming 3DGS: High-Quality Radiance Fields with Limited Resources
nodes.label: Taming 3DGS
nodes.note: 가우시안 수 예산을 지정하는 밀집화와 역전파 커널 최적화로 학습 메모리·시간을 크게 절감.
nodes.note_en: Densification under a fixed Gaussian budget and optimised backward kernels cut training memory and time substantially.

nodes.title: Triangle Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
nodes.label: Triangle Splatting
nodes.note: 미분 가능한 삼각형을 직접 최적화. 결과물이 기존 메시 래스터라이저와 바로 호환된다는 점이 핵심.
nodes.note_en: Optimises differentiable triangles directly. The key point is that the result works with standard mesh rasterisers.

nodes.title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
nodes.label: XClipGS
nodes.note: EWA 국소 아핀 모델에서 반공간으로 잘린 가우시안 적분 = 2D footprint × 조건부 가우시안 CDF. 닫힌 형식 클리핑.
nodes.note_en: Under EWA's local affine model, a Gaussian clipped by a half-space integrates exactly to its 2D footprint times a conditional Gaussian CDF: closed-form clipping.

edges.solves: 3D 타원체의 다시점 깊이 불일치로 기하가 부정확
edges.solves_en: 3D ellipsoids give inconsistent multi-view depth, so geometry is off

edges.solves: 표면 정렬 정규화를 표현 자체(2D 원판)로 해결
edges.solves_en: Turns the surface-alignment regulariser into the primitive itself (2D discs)

summary_en: 3DGS (2023) replaced NeRF-style ray marching with sorted rasterisation of anisotropic Gaussians and made real-time, high-quality rendering possible. It has since branched into compression and LOD, geometric accuracy (2DGS), dynamic scenes (4DGS), ray tracing (3DGRT, 3DGUT), new primitives (Triangle Splatting) and feed-forward reconstruction, and new stars still appear every month.
